text.en:
The Chairman of the Board and the General Manager of the Coconut Investment Company shall
be appointed by the President during the period that the Company is a government corporation. They shall,
together with the eleven (11) members specified under Republic Act No. 6260, comprise a Board of Directors
of 13 members which shall exercise the corporate powers of the Company.

Any and all provisions of Republic Act No. 6260 which are inconsistent herewith are hereby
repealed and/or amended accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 19th day of July, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-four.
